name: Cybeats Technologies Corp.
summary: Cybeats Technologies Corp. operates as a cybersecurity entity, offering specialized Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and software supply chain intelligence technologies. These tools are instrumental in empowering organizations to proactively address risks, achieve regulatory adherence, and fortify the security of their software throughout its entire journey, from initial acquisition and creation to ongoing deployment. The firm's proprietary platform ensures its clientele benefits from profound insight and comprehensive clarity regarding their software supply chain. Established in 2016, Cybeats Technologies Corp. maintains its base in Etobicoke, Canada.
